sources.title: Non-canonical kinetic structures in the swampland

evidence.text: DBI supplies a motivated example in which a relativistic speed limit permits inflation on potentials too steep for canonical slow roll. The paper tests the associated potential-gradient estimate.

sources.title: Reconstructing $k$-essence: Unifying the attractor $n_S(N)$ and the swampland criteria

evidence.text: Study inflation driven by one scalar whose quadratic kinetic term has a field-dependent coefficient. The theory retains the Einstein gravitational action and introduces two unknown functions, V(φ) and L(φ).

sources.title: Swampland conjecture and inflation model from brane perspective

evidence.text: How does a quadratic energy-density correction to the expansion rate alter single-field inflation? The parameter Λ sets the crossover between the ordinary Friedmann behavior and the brane-dominated regime.

sources.title: Scalar field inflation driven by a modification of the Heisenberg algebra

evidence.text: Can deformations of the Heisenberg algebra, implemented through classical Poisson brackets, support scalar-field inflation with an arbitrary starting potential, including exact exponential expansion and weaker potential slow-roll restrictions?

sources.title: The Standard Model Higgs boson as the inflaton

evidence.text: Can the Standard Model Higgs drive inflation and generate acceptable primordial perturbations through a non-minimal gravitational coupling, without introducing an additional inflaton particle?

sources.title: Disentangling the $f(R)$ - Duality

evidence.text: How do decaying exponentials, rising exponentials, and monomial deformations of inflationary plateaus change their f(R) descriptions, including asymptotic powers, closed-form reconstructibility, and observable inflationary behavior?

sources.title: Gauss-Bonnet Inflation

evidence.text: Can a scalar coupled to the Gauss–Bonnet invariant generate early de Sitter expansion and an exit without an imposed scalar self-potential, after neglecting the Einstein–Hilbert term in a proposed strong-gravity regime?

sources.title: Warm DBI inflation with constant sound speed

evidence.text: Dissipation can maintain radiation during inflation and permit slow expansion on a steep potential. The paper assumes an equilibrated bath whose energy production changes slowly compared with dilution.

sources.title: Note on single-field inflation and the swampland criteria

evidence.text: Can radiation production during inflation remove the need for an oscillatory reheating minimum while permitting inflation on a potential restricted by the Swampland conjectures?

sources.title: Warm inflation as a way out of the swampland

evidence.text: How does continuous energy transfer from an inflaton to radiation change inflation compared with an effectively isolated inflaton? The bath can remain populated during accelerated expansion while potential energy dominates.

sources.title: Warm inflation as a way out of the swampland

evidence.text: Can dissipation complement brane corrections or modified kinetic terms that already permit steeper potentials? The paper presents this as an additional route beyond its canonical quartic examples.

sources.title: Reheating After Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: Can interactions with light fields sustain inflation while transferring energy to radiation? The source represents this possibility through an enhanced friction term in the homogeneous inflaton equation.

sources.title: $\alpha$-attractor from superconformal E-models in brane inflation

evidence.text: Do superconformal E-model potentials retain inflationary attractors in Randall–Sundrum II brane cosmology, and how do brane corrections affect ns, r, parameter degeneracies and sub-Planckian field excursions?

sources.title: A note on supergravity inflation in braneworld

evidence.text: Can supergravity-motivated power-law potentials with exponential suppression yield observationally compatible inflation and sub-Planckian field excursions when embedded phenomenologically in braneworld cosmology?

sources.title: Logarithmic corrected $f(R)$ gravitational model and swampland conjectures

evidence.text: Determine whether corrected f(R) inflation can accommodate the paper's conjectured quantum-gravity restrictions and reported cosmological information, and whether those requirements constrain the curvature exponent and correction coefficients.

sources.title: Swampland, axions, and minimal warm inflation

evidence.text: Does adding explicit thermal friction rescue the simplest steep exponential potential from its cold-inflation problems?

sources.title: Swampland, axions, and minimal warm inflation

evidence.text: How do expansion, inflaton motion, and a thermal gauge bath exchange energy during inflation?

sources.title: Warm tachyon inflation and swampland criteria

evidence.text: Describe inflation driven by a noncanonical tachyon while a radiation bath remains present. Both components source expansion, although subsequent calculations assume tachyon dominance.

sources.title: Strengthening the de Sitter swampland conjecture in warm inflation

evidence.text: Can energy dissipated by the inflaton maintain a thermal radiation bath while the universe inflates?

sources.title: Swampland implications of GW170817-compatible Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet gravity

evidence.text: The setting describes inflation driven by one canonical scalar coupled to the Gauss–Bonnet invariant. This interaction changes homogeneous evolution and cosmological perturbation propagation and normalization.

sources.title: Graceful exit problem in warm inflation

evidence.text: Under which combinations of inflaton potential, dissipative coefficient and weak or strong dissipation does warm inflation end gracefully, with radiation overtaking the inflaton energy rather than persistent overdamped inflation?

sources.title: CMB from a Gauss-Bonnet-induced de Sitter fixed point

evidence.text: Can de Sitter fixed points sustained by a balance between a massive scalar potential and a scalar-dependent Gauss-Bonnet coupling generate CMB-compatible fluctuations, and thereby constrain the coupling function?

sources.title: Cosmic inflation from broken conformal symmetry

evidence.text: Can an asymptotically flat inflationary potential emerge from Palatini quadratic gravity by appropriately breaking local conformal symmetry in matter kinetic and effective potential terms, without imposing an additional global symmetry?

sources.title: Further Refining Swampland Conjecture on Inflation in General Scalar-Tensor Theories of Gravity

evidence.text: How does a phenomenological power-law correction modify nonminimally coupled quartic inflation and its potential-derivative constraints?

sources.title: Swampland conjectures in hybrid metric-Palatini gravity

evidence.text: The potential family tests whether changing the exponent away from the previously discussed quadratic case can improve simultaneous inflationary and swampland compatibility in the hybrid model.

sources.title: Swampland conjectures in hybrid metric-Palatini gravity

evidence.text: The hybrid action retains metric curvature R while adding f(𝓡), where 𝓡 is built from an independent connection. The construction supplies the modified gravitational dynamics used for the inflationary application.

sources.title: Swampland conjectures in hybrid metric-Palatini gravity

evidence.text: Does a power-law-potential realization of hybrid metric-Palatini inflation admit a common regime satisfying cosmological observations and the paper's de Sitter swampland inequalities? The proposed test uses ns, r, and potential-derivative ratios.

sources.title: Constraints on cosmological parameters in light of the scalar–tensor theory of gravity and swampland conjectures

evidence.text: Can power-law, exponential and logarithmic inflationary models in nonminimally coupled scalar–tensor gravity satisfy the paper's de Sitter swampland conditions while producing cosmological parameters compatible with its observational benchmarks?

sources.title: Swampland dS conjecture in mimetic $f(R, T)$ gravity

evidence.text: Can reconstructed inflationary histories in mimetic f(R,T)=R+δT gravity satisfy observational constraints and refined or further-refined de Sitter swampland criteria?

sources.title: Non-minimally coupled Natural Inflation: Palatini and Metric formalism with the recent BICEP/Keck

evidence.text: How does a polynomial nonminimal inflaton–curvature coupling change natural-inflation predictions for ns, r and α in Metric and Palatini formulations, and which sampled parameters agree with the BICEP/Keck contours used in this 2022 paper under specified reheating histories?

sources.title: The Standard Model Higgs boson as the inflaton

evidence.text: The analysis uses Einstein-frame potential slow-roll parameters, the e-fold integral and the COBE normalization U/ε=(0.027MP)⁴. The authors state that the same inflationary results can be obtained in the Jordan frame.

sources.title: Disentangling the $f(R)$ - Duality

evidence.text: Weyl transformation gives V=(f′R−f)/(2f′²). Reconstruction substitutes f′=exp(κφ), differentiates the resulting equation to solve for f′, and integrates; the original undifferentiated equation fixes the lost integration constant.

sources.title: Gauss-Bonnet Inflation

evidence.text: For f=λφ² in the Ricci-free model, the authors reduce the system to a Hubble evolution equation and integrate it for k=0. The relation φ²ȧ⁵=C0 is used to determine the scalar evolution, and a recursive Hubble-parameter hierarchy characterizes departure from inflation.

sources.title: Warm DBI inflation with constant sound speed

evidence.text: Specify H(φ), reconstruct the DBI velocity and sound speed, calculate logarithmic derivatives, and integrate the remaining e-folds. A potential supplies H approximately when its energy dominates.

sources.title: Note on single-field inflation and the swampland criteria

evidence.text: Compute Q and the potential and dissipation derivatives, test the warm slow-roll hierarchy, and solve the friction balance when acceleration is negligible. Bath stability and perturbations require separate checks.

sources.title: Warm inflation as a way out of the swampland

evidence.text: Differentiate the dissipation law at fixed coefficient and exponent, replace temperature perturbations through the bath equation of state, then solve the coupled fluctuation problem. The response function requires that additional dynamics; the algebraic variation only exposes the coupling.

sources.title: Chaotic inflation on the brane and the Swampland Criteria

evidence.text: Can modified expansion in a braneworld support single-field slow-roll inflation with a small field excursion and an order-one potential slope while retaining acceptable scalar and tensor spectra?

sources.title: Implications of single field inflation in general cosmological scenarios on the nature of dark energy given the swampland conjectures

evidence.text: How do scalar inflation and quintessence constraints change when the background expansion relation is F(H)=ρtot/3 rather than H²=ρtot/3? The paper varies the background function while retaining ordinary canonical scalar dynamics.

sources.title: Primordial Black Holes and the String Swampland

evidence.text: Can altered degrees of freedom, kinetic terms, initial states, or conjectural criteria evade the conventional scalar-power argument?

sources.title: Chaotic inflation on the brane and the Swampland Criteria

evidence.text: Which changes to the perturbation source, inflationary dynamics, or initial state have been proposed to ease the conjectural constraints?

sources.title: Non-canonical kinetic structures in the swampland

evidence.text: Small ε describes quasi-de Sitter expansion, while small η permits persistent inflation. These conditions constrain the expansion history without requiring a shallow potential or automatically negligible scalar acceleration.

sources.title: Geometrical scalar back-reaction effects in inflation

evidence.text: Can retained geometrical boundary contributions generate scalar and tensor spacetime waves during cold and warm inflation, and how does radiation affect their evolution?

sources.title: Swampland, axions, and minimal warm inflation

evidence.text: Which conjectural restrictions on scalar potentials, field-space excursion, and primordial fluctuation histories are imposed on the inflationary examples?

sources.title: k - inflation

evidence.text: Can nonquadratic scalar kinetic terms, without a potential, generate expanding Einstein-frame inflation with decreasing curvature, acceptable scalar perturbations and a graceful transition to a radiation-dominated universe?

sources.title: Spinodal solution to swampland inflationary constraints

evidence.text: Does a potential-slope restriction exclude inflation when non-equilibrium fluctuations control the evolution? The authors propose assessing the relevant slope safety through the potential-driven stage.

sources.title: Note on single-field inflation and the swampland criteria

evidence.text: Can single-field inflation satisfy conjectural quantum-gravity restrictions on its potential while reproducing a small tensor-to-scalar ratio and a nearly scale-invariant scalar spectrum?

sources.title: Seed models in scalar field cosmology

evidence.text: Can extrema of scalar-field variation restrict and relate canonical single-field Einstein-gravity cosmologies, test their inflationary predictions, and organize their post-inflationary evolution into seed models for modified gravity?

sources.title: Composite inflation and further refining dS swampland conjecture

evidence.text: A nonminimally coupled composite NJL scalar is used to generate a plateau inflationary potential.

sources.title: Cosmological consequences of a principle of finite amplitudes

evidence.text: Can R+R² scalar inflation remain dominant toward a small-volume anisotropic past?

sources.title: Reconstructing $k$-essence: Unifying the attractor $n_S(N)$ and the swampland criteria

evidence.text: Test whether the reconstructed inflationary functions satisfy conjectural restrictions on scalar displacement and potential steepness. The source applies these inequalities directly to φ despite its field-dependent kinetic coefficient.

sources.title: On the Field Excursion Bound

evidence.text: What enforces the flat FRW scalar field excursion bound, when can it saturate, and how robust is it to inflationary fluctuations, higher-derivative kinetics and spatial curvature?

sources.title: Reconstructing $k$-essence: Unifying the attractor $n_S(N)$ and the swampland criteria

evidence.text: Determine whether a scalar inflation model can reproduce a prescribed spectral-index attractor while obeying assumed bounds on field excursion and potential slope. The unknown functions are the potential and the coefficient of the scalar kinetic term.

sources.title: Swampland distance conjecture, inflation and $\alpha$-attractors

evidence.text: Which kinetic and potential structures make inflationary observables insensitive to a range of model details?

sources.title: Avoiding the string swampland in single-field inflation: Excited initial states

evidence.text: Can additional gravitational friction permit inflation on a steep canonical scalar potential without weakening the conjectured slope bound?

sources.title: Gauss–Bonnet Inflation and the String Swampland

evidence.text: Can a scalar-dependent curvature coupling change inflationary observables enough to accommodate a steep potential and a small field excursion?
